models.name: todo_users
models.description:
User accounts for personal todo management.

Represents individual authenticated users of the Todo List application. Each user owns their own collection of todos and has access restricted strictly to their account. No profile, roles, or shared/group features exist in this minimal application. Supports secure authentication using a unique email and hashed password. Created and updated timestamps track registration and account changes. No soft deletion or role-based access control is present, in line with privacy and simplicity requirements.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for account authentication and identifier. Must be unique across all users. Required for login and password reset flows.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password (never plain text). Used for secure authentication only.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created (UTC). Used for audit and business reporting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last change to this user account (credentials, metadata, etc.). Allows business auditing and security checks.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated user access.

Tracks individual login sessions for each user, supporting multi-device or concurrent sign-ins. Stores context information such as IP address, connecting URL, and referrer for audit and security analysis. Each session is linked to a single user and has a clear start (created_at) and optional expiry (expired_at) timestamp. Enables audit trails for user actions and supports secure logout flows. Managed exclusively via authentication flows; not created or deleted independently by users.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. Links session to user. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created. Used for security audits.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL at login. Useful for logging entry points and UI context of session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL provided by the browser or client during login session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was established (UTC). Allows analysis of user activity and session management.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired or was terminated. Null when session is active.

models.name: todo_todos
models.description:
Individual todo items owned by a specific user.

Represents a single unit of personal task management, strictly scoped to one authenticated user per business and privacy requirements. A todo includes a required title, optional description, optional due date, optional priority, and flags for completion status and completion timestamp. Each todo is private, never shared, and uniquely associated via a required foreign key to the owning user (see {@link todo_users}).

All CRUD operations, status toggling, and per-user filtering are supported directly on this table. Business rule validation (such as duplicate title/date per user) is enforced at the application logic level. Deletion is irreversible (no soft delete). Creation and update metadata support audit and recovery scenarios.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for a todo item.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user ID. References the owning authenticated user. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short descriptive title for the todo item. Required per business rules. Maximum length: 255 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer details or notes for the todo. Maximum length: 1000 characters. May be null if no description provided.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 format. Must be a valid date in the future or null if undated.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Optional task priority. Valid values: 'low', 'medium', 'high'. May be null if no priority assigned.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. True if completed, false otherwise.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked as completed. Null if incomplete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime the todo item was created (UTC, ISO 8601).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime the todo item was last modified (UTC, ISO 8601).
